attribute_fields.COMMENTS: Calculates education credits (AOTC and LLC) per Form 8863, Publication 970, IRC 25A. AOTC is up to $2,500 for first 4 years of college (40% refundable). LLC is up to $2,000 for any post-secondary education.

initial_action.action_description: set result.education_credit = 0, initialize AOTC refundable/nonrefundable, for all dependents perform Calculate_Education_Credit_Per_Dependent
initial_action.action_postfix: 0.0 /result.education_credit xdef 0.0 /result.total_aotc_refundable xdef 0.0 /result.total_aotc_nonrefundable xdef { Calculate_Education_Credit_Per_Dependent performaliased } job.dependents forall
